en.tutorial.title: Starter Tutorial
en.tutorial.step.1: Prologue: You are a Doctor thrown into this cave for training.
en.tutorial.step.2: Movement: use W A S D. You can also click with the mouse in menus.
en.tutorial.step.3: Combat: move into hostile mobs to attack. Keep an eye on HP and MP.
en.tutorial.step.4: Interact: stand near an NPC and press F. In dialog, use Up/Down then Enter.
en.tutorial.step.5: System menu: press ESC to open Item, Hotbar, Equipment, Objective, Save, and Leave.
en.tutorial.step.6: Goal: survive, earn robux, and push Rogue layers when ready.
en.manual.title: Game Manual
en.manual.hint: Enter/Space/Click: next page, ESC: back to menu
en.manual.step.1: Move like a pro: W A S D. Hold a direction to keep moving.
en.manual.step.2: Combat basics: bump hostile mobs to attack. Keep HP/MP healthy.
en.manual.step.3: Use ESC for system panels: Item, Hotbar, Equipment, Team, Objective, Save.
en.manual.step.4: Item panel has two layers: tabs then item list. Enter to go deeper, ESC to go back.
en.manual.step.5: Hotbar quick swap: press I to toggle Item/Magic bar, then use 1-0 keys.
en.manual.step.6: Core loop: farm robux, gear up, clear maps, then push Rogue deeper.
en.team.hint_equip: Slots layer: A/D slot, W/S member, Enter items. Items layer: W/S item, Enter equip, ESC back.

zh.tutorial.hint: Enter/Space/滑鼠左鍵 下一步，ESC 跳過
zh.tutorial.step.1: 開場：你是博士，被丟進洞穴做實戰訓練。
zh.tutorial.step.2: 移動：使用 W A S D。選單也可以用滑鼠點擊。
zh.tutorial.step.3: 戰鬥：移動碰觸敵對怪物即可攻擊，注意 HP 與 MP。
zh.tutorial.step.4: 互動：靠近 NPC 後按 F。對話中用上下鍵選擇、Enter 確認。

zh.manual.title: 操作手冊
zh.manual.hint: Enter/Space/滑鼠左鍵 下一頁，ESC 返回選單
zh.manual.step.1: 移動：W A S D。長按方向鍵可連續移動。
zh.manual.step.2: 戰鬥：碰到敵對怪物就會攻擊，注意維持 HP/MP。
zh.manual.step.3: 系統操作：按 ESC 開啟物品、快捷欄、裝備、隊伍、目標、存檔。
zh.manual.step.4: 物品面板是兩層：先分類，再道具清單。Enter 深入，ESC 退回。
zh.manual.step.5: 快捷欄：按 I 在道具/魔法欄切換，再用 1-0 快速施放。
zh.manual.step.6: 遊戲循環：刷 Robux、強化裝備、清圖，再往 Rogue 更深層推進。
zh.team.hint_equip: 槽位層：A/D 切槽位、W/S 切隊友、Enter 進入道具層。道具層：W/S 選道具、Enter 裝備、ESC 返回。
